text:
sasha: Pushed changes to address retry/backoff comments. Moved the policy into retry_policy.py, added unit tests, and adjusted the default base backoff to 100ms. PTAL when you have a sec.

olivia: Nice. Quick question — why 100ms instead of 50ms? Any perf numbers to justify the change?

sasha: TL;DR: 100ms smooths out spikes on short sequences. Local microbench showed fewer retry storms and slightly better tail. Paste of the quick numbers below.

```
before (base=50ms): 95th token latency = 420ms
after  (base=100ms): 95th token latency = 385ms
```

raj: tiny nit — can we make the base backoff configurable via env var? e.g. REDWOOD_RETRY_BASE_MS so ops can tweak without a deploy.

sasha: good call, added env var support in commit 6a3f9d8. The code uses `int(os.getenv('REDWOOD_RETRY_BASE_MS', '100'))` so default stays 100ms.

olivia: left one comment on the jitter behavior in retry_policy.py docstring (small wording). also please add a one-line changelog entry under components/retry/CHANGELOG.md.

sasha: applied the docstring wording and added changelog line: "tune: adjust default retry base to 100ms and add env override". PTAL again when you can.

ci-bot: CI results: 42 passed, 0 failed. Coverage 87.2% :white_check_mark: (jobs: unit-tests, linters)

mike: skimmed the diff, looks good to me. LGTM once Olivia is happy with the docstring. Can we target merge in the 10:00 PT canary slot tomorrow?

olivia: rechecked the docstring change — looks clear now. :thumbsup: Approve.

sasha: thanks all. I'll squash the minor fixups and schedule the merge for the 10:00 PT canary slot. I'll ping here right before merging.

raj: no objections from me. thanks for addressing the feedback.

sasha: scheduling noted — will ping at merge time.
